name: Romana Jerković - Proposition de résolution
title: REPORT on an EU cardiovascular diseases strategy
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its position on the European Commission's plan for heart and blood vessel diseases, called the Safe Hearts Plan. It asks for stronger prevention, earlier diagnosis and equal access to care across the EU. It wants action on smoking, alcohol, unhealthy food, lack of exercise and pollution. It also calls for national heart health plans in every member state, better data, more research and a focus on women, who are often diagnosed late.

- **What changes:** Parliament gives its opinion; it does not change laws itself. It asks for national heart plans, prevention and screening.
- **Who it affects:** People in the EU at risk of heart disease, patients, doctors and national health systems.
- **What happens next:** The Commission and member states are asked to act on these ideas; Parliament will review progress later.
